name: CF Montréal
description: A321neo (LR)s C-GOKE (fin 716) and C-GOKG (fin 718) in Air Transat's scheme with CF Montréal's colours on the rear fuselage: behind the wing a navy field rises from the belly to the crown at the fin's root, ahead of a curved white stripe and then Transat's blue, which covers the tail cone; CF Montréal's round crest (a navy roundel ringed in white, 'CF MONTRÉAL' over and '1993' under a black disc with the club's white emblem) large on the navy over the wing's trailing edge; a darker blue star outline low in the blue; the fin, titles and winglets as Air Transat's standard.

titles.style: 'Air' in bold light blue, rounded sans, over the forward windows behind the door. As on Air Transat's standard (TSC/standard), checked on the left side.
'transat' straight after, lower case, semibold, in navy. As on Air Transat's standard (TSC/standard), checked on the left side.
'Air' in bold light blue, rounded sans, over the forward windows behind the door. As on Air Transat's standard (TSC/standard), checked on the left side.
'transat' straight after, lower case, semibold, in navy. As on Air Transat's standard (TSC/standard), checked on the left side.

logos.description: The Transat star: a large five-pointed star drawn as a thick white outline with blue inside, slightly tilted, on the aft fin, its lower point running down across the rear fuselage.
A small star outline on the winglet.
A small Canadian flag behind the cockpit.

CF Montréal's crest drawn as our own simplified mark: a navy roundel with a white ring, 'CF MONTRÉAL' round its top and '1993' at its foot, a black disc in the middle with the club's white emblem (a stylised fleur-de-lis). Large on the navy behind the wing, reaching above it into the white.

notes: Left side only (C-GOKE 2025-03-29, C-GOKG 2026-07-31; the press pieces' photos weren't used): the right side is assumed the same, the crest facing forward. The navy's front edge behind the crest is hidden and drawn as a smooth run between where it shows. Not drawn: the darker blue star outline low in the blue (part of the Transat star motif), the registration. The fin's Transat star, titles and winglets are TSC/standard's. Current: C-GOKG in it on 2026-07-31. The stripe between the navy and the blue reads white on C-GOKE and pale silver-grey on C-GOKG (light, or a metallic ink): drawn white.
history: New 2026-11-22. Unveiled at the end of September 2024 for Air Transat's partnership with the Montréal football club.
